title: The Kite at Night
lines: Meg tied a light to her big kite.
At night she ran in the dark park.
The kite went up high in the sky.
The light shone bright and white.
Ben ran up to see the big star.
"That is not a star," said Meg.
The wind was strong and the string was tight.
The kite fell in a tall tree.
But Ben got it back with a long pole.
They sat and ate pie in the dark.

questions.ask: What did Ben think the light in the sky was?
questions.listenFor: He thought it was a star. If your child is not sure, have them reread the line where Ben runs up.
The wind was strong, so the string snapped. Two steps - let them find both instead of telling them.

questions.ask: Do you think Meg will fly her kite at night again? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason from the story, like the string snapping or how bright the light looked.
